Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments analyzed material purified via FLAG-immunoprecipitation of WDR5 complexes and anti-PDPK1 immunoprecipitation of PDPK1. While the text mentions that the PDPK1-WDR5 interaction occurs in the nucleus, the material actually analyzed by MS was the purified protein/complex eluted from affinity beads, not a crude nuclear fraction.
